mechanism: Amitriptyline may reduce levonorgestrel efficacy through hepatic enzyme induction and increased metabolism, while levonorgestrel may increase amitriptyline levels through CYP450 inhibition, potentially elevating tricyclic antidepressant concentrations.
action: Monitor for reduced contraceptive efficacy and amitriptyline toxicity; consider alternative contraception or amitriptyline dose adjustment if needed; counsel on breakthrough bleeding risk.
